speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Wipe the board. A clean board is the end of dinner. I am not keeping a dish out in case of a second thought.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The heel can go to the morning. I am not throwing bread because a man has left the crust. Two meals can share a loaf in this weather.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I am at the door. If your candle is late, it is your candle. The ceiling has had its feet for today.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Go to the loom. I am going up. There is a letter on the board and it is not walking out behind either of you.
